title: INSTALLATION OF THROTTLE BODY
ocr_text:
FI-104

EFI SYSTEM — Air Induction System

INSTALLATION OF THROTTLE BODY
(7M-GE)

1. INSTALL THROTTLE BODY
(a) Install the VTV.
(b) Install the gasket and throttle body with the four bolts.
Torque: 130 kg·cm (9 ft·lb, 13 N·m)

2. CONNECT THROTTLE BODY BRACKET

3. CONNECT AIR CLEANER HOSE

4. CONNECT THROTTLE POSITION SENSOR CONNECTOR

5. CONNECT VACUUM HOSES

6. CONNECT WATER HOSES

7. CONNECT ACCELERATOR CONNECTING ROD

8. REFILL WITH COOLANT

(7M-GTE)

1. INSTALL THROTTLE BODY
(a) Install the VTV.
(b) Install the two water by-pass hoses.

(c) Install a new gasket and throttle body with the four bolts.

(d) Connect the two water by-pass hoses to the ISC valve and water pipe.
